T: Five golden tickets. One very sweet tour.
D: A poor boy wins a tour of a reclusive chocolatier's factory along with four very badly behaved children.
P: Serve the three-course dinner when Violet grabs the experimental gum.
S: Bucket family cabbage and bacon soup
the thin soup the Buckets eat every night

A proper version: savoy cabbage, onion, carrot and potato simmered in chicken stock with smoky bacon and thyme, finished with butter, pepper and crusty bread. Fry 150g diced bacon in a large pot until golden. Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots and soften 5 minutes. Add 2 diced potatoes, 1.5L chicken stock and thyme and simmer 15 minutes. Add half a savoy cabbage, shredded, and simmer 10 minutes more. Stir in 30g butter, season with plenty of pepper and serve with crusty bread.
the bar with the golden ticket inside
Dark chocolate tempered and poured into bar moulds, one bar in the batch with a gold foil ticket hidden under the wrapper.
the squirrels sorting nuts for Veruca's tantrum
Walnuts, pecans and almonds tossed in egg white, brown sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes, stirred twice.
M: the gum that tastes of tomato soup and roast beef

Little cups of roast tomato and basil soup to start, then sirloin roasted pink and sliced, with baked potatoes loaded with butter and sour cream. Roast 1kg halved tomatoes, an onion and 3 garlic cloves at 200C for 35 minutes, then blitz with 300ml stock and basil for soup. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear all over and roast at 200C to 52C inside, about 30 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice. Split the potatoes and load with butter, sour cream and chives.
the German boy who falls in the chocolate river

Bratwurst grilled slowly until browned and juicy, with warm apple and caraway sauerkraut, soft pretzels and plenty of wholegrain mustard. Simmer a 500g jar of sauerkraut with a grated apple, 125ml apple juice and 1 tsp caraway seeds for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Warm 4 soft pretzels at 180C for 5 minutes. Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.
W: the third course of the gum, the one that turns Violet blue
Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours, with vanilla ice cream.
K: the chocolate river, mixed by waterfall
Dark and milk chocolate melted into hot milk and cream, whisked hard until frothy, the way the waterfall churns it.

s.note: the bar with the golden ticket inside
s.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and 100g milk chocolate gently and pour into 4 bar moulds. Sprinkle a little flaky salt on top and set in the fridge for an hour. Wrap each in paper, slipping a gold foil ticket under one wrapper.

s.note: the squirrels sorting nuts for Veruca's tantrum
s.how: Whisk 1 egg white until frothy, then toss with 100g each of walnuts, pecans and almonds. Coat in 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Roast at 160C for 20 minutes, stirring twice, then cool and break apart.

m.note: the German boy who falls in the chocolate river
m.how: Simmer a 500g jar of sauerkraut with a grated apple, 125ml apple juice and 1 tsp caraway seeds for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Warm 4 soft pretzels at 180C for 5 minutes. Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.

w.note: the third course of the gum, the one that turns Violet blue
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, the juice of a lemon and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes, cool 3 hours and serve with ice cream.

d.note: the chocolate river, mixed by waterfall
d.how: Heat 800ml milk and 200ml cream until steaming. Whisk in 100g dark chocolate and 50g milk chocolate, chopped, and keep whisking hard until it's thick and frothy like the waterfall. Pour into four mugs.
